_comment: Company outlook data blended into the match score. health = how well the company is doing; security = how stable a new hire's job is likely to be; industry outlook comes from the 'industries' table. 'basis' says whether a rating rests on research gathered 2026-11-20 (Sayari corporate records + Tavily news) or is an estimate from general knowledge. Edit freely; unlisted companies get a neutral 60.

ai.label: AI / frontier tech
ai.note: Heaviest venture funding of any sector in 2026; fast hiring, but valuations are high.

fintech.label: Fintech
fintech.note: Strong 2026 funding and M&A (Ramp $60B, Capital One–Brex). Startup layoffs in H1 2026 were below 2024–25 levels (Carta data).

financial_data.label: Financial data & information
financial_data.note: Consolidating at high prices (LSEG–Octus $3.5B); subscription revenue is durable.

trading.label: Trading firms & hedge funds
trading.note: Record trading revenues in volatile markets; pay is high, retention is performance-driven.

asset_mgmt.label: Asset management, PE & VC
asset_mgmt.note: Private markets keep growing (Deloitte 2027 outlook); hiring is selective.

banking.label: Banking & investment banking
banking.note: Deloitte 2027 outlook: capital repricing and AI adoption. IB hiring is cyclical; large banks are stable employers.

insurance.label: Insurance (P&C, specialty)
insurance.note: US insurance payrolls fell ~90,000 over the 12 months to Oct 2026 (BLS, via Intelligent Insurer). Specialty lines (cyber, political risk) remain in demand.

health_insurance.label: Health insurance
health_insurance.note: ACA marketplace membership expected flat in 2027; regulatory risk.

construction_re.label: Construction & real estate
construction_re.note: High rates squeeze development; data-center and infrastructure builds are the bright spot.

energy_infra.label: Renewable energy & infrastructure finance
energy_infra.note: Project pipelines strong but exposed to federal tax-credit changes.

software.label: Enterprise software
software.note: Steady growth; AI is reshaping go-to-market teams.

consumer.label: Consumer, retail & fashion
consumer.note: Tariffs and soft discretionary spending pressure margins.

professional.label: Law & professional services
professional.note: Stable demand; finance teams at large firms are steady employers.

staffing.label: Recruiter posting (employer undisclosed)
staffing.note: Posted through a staffing firm, so the real employer can't be assessed.

public_nonprofit.label: Public sector & nonprofit
public_nonprofit.note: Stable, slower-moving; pay below private sector.

media.label: Media
media.note: Structural pressure; leaders with subscriptions (NYT) are the exception.

healthcare.label: Healthcare services & health tech
healthcare.note: Demand grows with an aging population; startups depend on funding.
